title: WisKey release manifest (arx-exchange schema 1)
description: release-manifest.json delivered in ready/<version>/. Strict: unknown fields are rejected; a new field needs schema 2. The Ed25519 signature covers the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the whole object without the top-level 'signature' member, no prehash. JSON with duplicate keys at any depth is rejected before schema validation. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in CRITERIA.md and GATE.md and are enforced by the Arx gate.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version. Arx rejects any other value.

profile.description: 'release' = signed package for the exchange folder. 'bootstrap' = unsigned package built and tested inside the Arx image only; Arx rejects it on every external path (receipt code R_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_EXTERNAL).

domain.description: Must equal the domain in custom_components/<install_dir>/manifest.json inside the install ZIP. Allowed values are an Arx-local list (today: hikvision_intercom).

install_dir.description: Arx installs to custom_components/<install_dir>/. Allowed values are an Arx-local list (today: hikvision_intercom).

version.description: SemVer 2.0 without build metadata (build metadata does not order). Release candidates as X.Y.Z-rc.N.

source_commit.description: Full lowercase git commit id the package was built from.

artifacts_sha256.description: Relative path (inside ready/<version>/) to lowercase SHA-256. Covers every file except the two ZIPs, release-manifest.json and READY.json. Arx verifies each file before showing or using it. A file present in ready/<version>/ but missing from this map is a rejection (R_ARTIFACT_EXTRA).

tested_ha_versions.description: Exact HA versions actually tested. No wildcards such as 2026.10.x.

contract_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR, equal to contract/CONTRACT_VERSION. Independent of the package version. FORMAT TO_BE_CONFIRMED by WisKey.

storage_schemas.description: One entry per storage store the integration owns, changed or not. Key = store key as used under .storage/. See CRITERIA.md section 3.

migrations.description: Empty array = no migration. A non-empty list is never installed automatically.

risk_to_doors.description: See CRITERIA.md section 2. Automatic install (if the owner enabled it) only for 'none'.

test_command.description: Exact command run inside the gate sandbox, for example: python -m pytest -q -o addopts="" -p no:cacheprovider --junitxml=<report>

ha_test_version.description: HA version installed in the gate environment (from requirements-ha-test.txt).

test_runtime_budget_seconds.description: Measured runtime budget of the test command. Upper bound 1800 is an Arx proposal, TO_BE_CONFIRMED.

tests_excluded.description: Number of test cases not delivered to the Arx gate. Must equal the length of tests-manifest.json 'excluded'.

signed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC with Z, whole seconds, the real signing time of the release event. Display and audit only; never used for trust, ordering or expiry. Empty string only in the bootstrap profile.

signature.description: Signature object in the release profile; null only in the bootstrap profile.

allOf.description: Removing a WS command or an entity is always breaking (CRITERIA.md 1.1).
Any migration requires rollback by HA backup restore (CRITERIA.md 5).

ha_version.description: Exact HA CalVer YEAR.MONTH.PATCH. Pre-release HA versions are not accepted.

relpath.description: Relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no backslash, no '.' or '..' segment, no empty segment, no hidden file.

key_id.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the 32 raw public key bytes. Arx trusts only keys pinned and approved on the Arx side, never a key shipped in a package.

value.description: Standard Base64 (with padding) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

version.description: Store schema version after this release.

previous_version.description: Version in the previous published release; null for a store new in this release.

irreversible.description: true when data written by this version cannot be read by the previous version.

removed.description: true when this release stops using the store. Removing a store is breaking.

target.description: Store key, config-entry, registry or domain that the migration changes.

reversible.description: false must match irreversible: true in storage_schemas for the same store.

dry_run.description: A dry-run mode that reports changes without writing is mandatory.

backup_before.description: The migration writes a backup of every file it touches before changing it.

method.description: reinstall_previous only when no store version changed, no migration and breaking is false. Otherwise restore_ha_backup. Arx never downgrades automatically; the bad version goes to the Arx-local blocked_versions list.
